families.types de données/descripteurs/flags/swiz: Data types, descriptors, flags and swizzle

buffers.mapped-at-creation.title: Write initial buffer contents
buffers.mapped-at-creation.expectation: A buffer created mapped exposes its whole mapping immediately and becomes unmapped after unmap.

transfers.copy-offsets.title: Copy a byte sub-range between buffers
transfers.copy-offsets.expectation: A buffer-to-buffer copy honours byte offsets and sizes and leaves the rest of the destination untouched.

transfers.write-offsets.title: Write a data sub-range through the queue
transfers.write-offsets.expectation: writeBuffer writes from a data offset with an explicit size.

transfers.write-remaining.title: Write from a data offset to the end of the data
transfers.write-remaining.expectation: writeBuffer with the size omitted writes from the offset to the end of the data.

buffers.partial-map-remap.title: Read a mapped sub-range then remap the whole buffer
buffers.partial-map-remap.expectation: Read an aligned range then remap the whole buffer without keeping the invalidated view.

compute.auto-layout-constants.title: Dispatch with an automatic layout and a specialization constant
compute.auto-layout-constants.expectation: A compute pipeline with an automatic layout compiles and the specialization constant changes the dispatch result.

compute.explicit-layout-entrypoint.title: Dispatch with an explicit layout and an inferred entry point
compute.explicit-layout-entrypoint.expectation: A compute pipeline accepts an explicit layout and infers the entry point when the shader has a single one.

errors.empty-scope.title: An empty validation scope resolves to null
errors.empty-scope.expectation: A validation scope with no operation resolves to null and the scope stack stays balanced.

errors.invalid-buffer-usage.title: A buffer with no usage reports a validation error
errors.invalid-buffer-usage.expectation: An invalid creation is captured by the validation scope as a GPUValidationError.

errors.map-alignment.title: An unaligned mapping offset fails validation
errors.map-alignment.expectation: A mapping offset not aligned to 8 bytes fails validation and leaves the buffer unmapped.

buffers.map-destroyed.title: Mapping a destroyed buffer reports a validation error
buffers.map-destroyed.expectation: Mapping a destroyed buffer fails and cannot be reported as a success.

buffers.zero-initialized.title: Read a freshly created buffer
buffers.zero-initialized.expectation: A buffer reads back as zeros before anything writes to it.

buffers.map-write-roundtrip.title: Write through a mapped buffer
buffers.map-write-roundtrip.expectation: Mapped CPU writes are visible after unmapping and staging the buffer.

transfers.clear-buffer-range.title: Clear a byte range of a buffer
transfers.clear-buffer-range.expectation: clearBuffer zeroes only the requested byte range and leaves the rest unchanged.

transfers.copy-remaining.title: Copy the remaining source bytes
transfers.copy-remaining.expectation: Omitting the size copies from the source offset to the end of the source.

bindings.buffer-range.title: Bind an explicit buffer range
bindings.buffer-range.expectation: A buffer binding starts at its explicit offset, not at the buffer start; the explicit size is witnessed by the storage range-length case.

bindings.dynamic-uniform-offsets.title: Move a uniform binding with a dynamic offset
bindings.dynamic-uniform-offsets.expectation: Each dynamic offset selects a different aligned block of the same uniform buffer.

compute.indirect-dispatch.title: Dispatch workgroups from an indirect buffer
compute.indirect-dispatch.expectation: dispatchWorkgroupsIndirect takes its workgroup counts from the indirect buffer.

compute.ordered-passes.title: Order two compute passes in one submission
compute.ordered-passes.expectation: A later compute pass sees the value written by the earlier pass in the same submission.

transfers.write-texture-tight-rows.title: Upload tightly packed rows with writeTexture
transfers.write-texture-tight-rows.expectation: writeTexture accepts a row stride that is not a multiple of 256 and preserves the row order.

transfers.upload-padded-rows.title: Skip inter-row padding in a buffer-to-texture copy
transfers.upload-padded-rows.expectation: copyBufferToTexture reads rows at bytesPerRow, so padding bytes never reach the texels.

transfers.readback-offset-padding.title: Read texels back at an offset and stride
transfers.readback-offset-padding.expectation: copyTextureToBuffer writes at the destination offset and stride and leaves the other bytes untouched.

transfers.array-layer-stride.title: Stride between array layers
transfers.array-layer-stride.expectation: rowsPerImage and bytesPerRow set the layer stride of an array-texture upload.

transfers.write-subrectangle.title: Write a texture sub-rectangle
transfers.write-subrectangle.expectation: writeTexture changes only the addressed rectangle and keeps the surrounding texels.

transfers.texture-region-copy.title: Copy a texture region
transfers.texture-region-copy.expectation: copyTextureToTexture copies the addressed rectangle to the destination origin and leaves the rest unchanged.

transfers.mip-level-copy.title: Copy one mip level
transfers.mip-level-copy.expectation: copyTextureToTexture addresses a single mip level and ignores the others.

transfers.volume-slices.title: Copy depth slices of a 3D texture
transfers.volume-slices.expectation: One buffer image feeds each depth slice of a 3D texture copy.

textures.view-base-mip.title: Start a view at a mip level
textures.view-base-mip.expectation: A view's baseMipLevel selects the mip level its level 0 reads.

textures.view-base-layer.title: Start a view at an array layer
textures.view-base-layer.expectation: A view's baseArrayLayer selects the first array layer its local indices address.

textures.view-dimensions.title: Report dimensions relative to a view
textures.view-dimensions.expectation: textureDimensions and textureNumLevels are relative to the view's base level and level count.

textures.uint-load.title: Load integer texels exactly
textures.uint-load.expectation: A texture_2d<u32> load returns the stored words without float conversion.

textures.storage-write.title: Write a storage texture from compute
textures.storage-write.expectation: textureStore writes each texel addressed by the dispatch and the readback returns them exactly.

textures.srgb-decode.title: Decode an sRGB texel on load
textures.srgb-decode.expectation: Loading RGBA8UnormSrgb linearises RGB while alpha is used as-is.

textures.srgb-view-format.title: Read the same bytes through a linear and an sRGB view
textures.srgb-view-format.expectation: A viewFormats entry lets two views of one texture read the bytes linearly or sRGB-decoded.

textures.cube-faces.title: Sample the six cube faces
textures.cube-faces.expectation: A cube view maps each axis direction to its layer and a nearest sample returns that layer's colour.

sampling.nearest.title: Sample with nearest filtering
sampling.nearest.expectation: Nearest filtering picks the texel under the coordinate with no blending.

sampling.linear.title: Sample with linear filtering
sampling.linear.expectation: Linear filtering blends the two texels around the coordinate.

sampling.clamp.title: Clamp texture coordinates at the edge
sampling.clamp.expectation: ClampToEdge uses the edge texel for coordinates outside 0..1.

sampling.repeat.title: Wrap texture coordinates with repeat
sampling.repeat.expectation: Repeat maps coordinates outside 0..1 to their fractional part.

sampling.mirror-repeat.title: Mirror texture coordinates
sampling.mirror-repeat.expectation: MirrorRepeat reflects each period, mapping the opposite way from repeat.

sampling.explicit-mip.title: Select a mip level explicitly
sampling.explicit-mip.expectation: An explicit LOD selects the matching mip level.

sampling.linear-mip.title: Blend adjacent mip levels
sampling.linear-mip.expectation: A linear mipmap filter blends the two mip levels around the requested LOD.

sampling.lod-clamp.title: Clamp the requested LOD
sampling.lod-clamp.expectation: lodMinClamp and lodMaxClamp bound the LOD a sample uses.

render.vertex-buffer-offset.title: Offset a vertex buffer
render.vertex-buffer-offset.expectation: setVertexBuffer reads vertices from the given byte offset.

render.indexed-u16.title: Draw with 16-bit indices
render.indexed-u16.expectation: A uint16 index buffer drives drawIndexed over the referenced vertices.

render.indexed-u32-offset.title: Draw with 32-bit indices at an offset
render.indexed-u32-offset.expectation: A uint32 index buffer read from a byte offset drives drawIndexed.

render.first-vertex.title: Start drawing at a vertex offset
render.first-vertex.expectation: draw(firstVertex) begins the vertex stream at the given index.

render.base-vertex.title: Offset indexed vertices by a base vertex
render.base-vertex.expectation: drawIndexed(baseVertex) adds a constant to every index.

render.instanced-attributes.title: Supply per-instance attributes
render.instanced-attributes.expectation: An Instance step-mode buffer varies the offset and colour per instance.

render.viewport.title: Confine rendering to a viewport
render.viewport.expectation: setViewport restricts rasterisation to the given rectangle.

render.scissor.title: Clip rendering to a scissor rectangle
render.scissor.expectation: setScissorRect discards fragments outside the rectangle.

render.clear-only.title: Clear an attachment without drawing
render.clear-only.expectation: A pass with no draw keeps the clear value it stores.

render.load-preserves.title: Preserve an attachment across passes
render.load-preserves.expectation: A load pass keeps the content a prior store pass wrote.

render.color-write-mask.title: Mask the colour channels written
render.color-write-mask.expectation: writeMask writes only the selected channels and keeps the clear elsewhere.

blend.source-alpha.title: Blend with the source alpha
blend.source-alpha.expectation: SrcAlpha/OneMinusSrcAlpha composites a translucent fragment over the target.

blend.additive.title: Blend additively
blend.additive.expectation: One/One addition sums the fragment and the target.

blend.constant.title: Blend with a constant factor
blend.constant.expectation: setBlendConstant supplies the constant blend factor.

render.multiple-targets.title: Write several colour targets
render.multiple-targets.expectation: A fragment writes location 0 and 1 into two attachments read back separately.

render.srgb-encode.title: Encode an sRGB attachment
render.srgb-encode.expectation: An rgba8unorm-srgb target encodes linear fragments on write.

depth.less.title: Compare depth with Less
depth.less.expectation: A nearer fragment wins the depth test and blocks a later, farther one.

depth.greater.title: Compare depth with Greater
depth.greater.expectation: A farther fragment wins when the test is Greater.

depth.write-disabled.title: Disable depth writes for one draw
depth.write-disabled.expectation: A draw with depth writes off does not block a later fragment.

depth.load-preserves.title: Preserve depth across passes
depth.load-preserves.expectation: A depth load pass keeps the depth a prior store pass wrote.

stencil.replace-equal.title: Replace then compare stencil
stencil.replace-equal.expectation: A Replace draw stamps a reference the next Equal draw matches.

stencil.read-mask.title: Mask the stencil comparison bits
stencil.read-mask.expectation: stencilReadMask limits which bits the comparison uses.

stencil.write-mask.title: Mask the stencil written bits
stencil.write-mask.expectation: stencilWriteMask limits which bits a stencil operation changes.

stencil.depth-fail.title: Run the stencil depth-fail operation
stencil.depth-fail.expectation: depthFailOp runs when the depth test fails but the stencil test passes.

msaa.resolve.title: Resolve a multisampled attachment
msaa.resolve.expectation: A sample-count-4 attachment renders and resolves into a sample-count-1 target.

msaa.sample-mask-zero.title: Discard every sample with a mask of zero
msaa.sample-mask-zero.expectation: A pipeline sample mask of 0 lets no draw sample write, so the resolve keeps the clear.

bundles.draw.title: Draw from a render bundle
bundles.draw.expectation: A recorded bundle executes its pipeline and draw in a pass.

bundles.reuse.title: Reuse a render bundle across passes
bundles.reuse.expectation: One bundle runs unchanged over two differently cleared targets.

render.draw-indirect.title: Draw with indirect arguments
render.draw-indirect.expectation: drawIndirect reads its vertex count from a buffer; a zero count draws nothing.

render.draw-indexed-indirect.title: Draw indexed with indirect arguments
render.draw-indexed-indirect.expectation: drawIndexedIndirect reads its index count from a buffer.

queries.occlusion.title: Count visible samples with occlusion queries
queries.occlusion.expectation: An occlusion query contributes samples for a visible draw and none for a depth-rejected one.

render.indirect-first-instance.title: Set the first instance with indirect arguments
render.indirect-first-instance.expectation: With the IndirectFirstInstance feature, the indirect arguments select the base instance.

errors.texture-copy-row-alignment.title: Reject an unaligned copy row stride
errors.texture-copy-row-alignment.expectation: copyBufferToTexture requires bytesPerRow to be a multiple of 256.

errors.texture-copy-bounds.title: Reject a copy outside the texture
errors.texture-copy-bounds.expectation: A copy whose origin and size exceed the texture fails validation.

errors.missing-copy-usage.title: Reject a copy from a texture without copy usage
errors.missing-copy-usage.expectation: A texture created with only TextureBinding cannot be a copy source.

errors.dynamic-offset-alignment.title: Reject an unaligned dynamic offset
errors.dynamic-offset-alignment.expectation: A dynamic uniform offset must be aligned to the device limit.

errors.bindgroup-layout-mismatch.title: Reject a bind group that does not match the pipeline
errors.bindgroup-layout-mismatch.expectation: Setting a bind group whose layout differs from the pipeline's layout fails validation.

errors.nested-scopes.title: Capture an error in the innermost scope
errors.nested-scopes.expectation: Only the inner validation scope reports the error; the outer resolves to null.

queries.timestamp-resolve.title: Resolve pass timestamps
queries.timestamp-resolve.expectation: A compute pass resolves begin and end timestamps into a sentinel-prefilled range without disturbing other ranges, and the dispatched kernel's output is read back; no claim is made that a measurable time was written.

compute.shader-f16.title: Compute with half precision
compute.shader-f16.expectation: The f16 extension computes in half precision and widens the exact result.

adapter.request-and-capabilities.title: Request an adapter and read its capabilities
adapter.request-and-capabilities.expectation: A low-power hint still returns an adapter whose features, limits and identifying fields are observable, and a device requested without optional features cannot exceed the adapter.

device.required-limits.title: Request a device at the adapter's workgroup limit
device.required-limits.expectation: A device request may pin maxComputeWorkgroupSizeX to the adapter's own value, the device reports at least that bound and the kernel still runs.

device.reject-excess-limit.title: Reject a request above the adapter limit
device.reject-excess-limit.expectation: Requesting maxComputeWorkgroupSizeX one above the adapter's limit fails explicitly instead of returning a device that ignores it.

device.queue-and-object-labels.title: Label buffers, encoders, command buffers and the queue
device.queue-and-object-labels.expectation: Each label is readable and rewritable without stopping the objects from copying data; the queue label is restored.

errors.uncaptured-error.title: Deliver an uncaptured validation error
errors.uncaptured-error.expectation: Outside any error scope, an invalid buffer reaches the device's uncaptured-error callback as a GPUValidationError.

errors.scope-filter-routing.title: Route an error past a non-matching scope
errors.scope-filter-routing.expectation: A validation error passes an inner OutOfMemory scope untouched and is captured by the outer Validation scope.

shader.compilation-valid.title: Compile a valid shader
shader.compilation-valid.expectation: A valid shader module reports no error compilation message and still builds a pipeline that writes 37.

shader.compilation-invalid.title: Report an invalid shader
shader.compilation-invalid.expectation: A syntax error yields at least one error compilation message and a validation error; text, count and positions are not asserted.

compute.pipeline-async.title: Create a compute pipeline asynchronously
compute.pipeline-async.expectation: createComputePipelineAsync resolves a pipeline that dispatches and writes [7, 10, 13, 16].

render.pipeline-async.title: Create a render pipeline asynchronously
render.pipeline-async.expectation: createRenderPipelineAsync resolves a pipeline that renders the red triangle over a blue clear.

errors.async-compute-rejection.title: Reject an asynchronous compute pipeline
errors.async-compute-rejection.expectation: A missing entry point makes createComputePipelineAsync fail without a captured validation error.

errors.async-render-rejection.title: Reject an asynchronous render pipeline
errors.async-render-rejection.expectation: An invalid multisample count makes createRenderPipelineAsync fail without a captured validation error.

command.ordered-command-buffers.title: Run two command buffers in order
command.ordered-command-buffers.expectation: Two command buffers submitted together copy source to intermediate to output in list order.

command.debug-markers.title: Wrap commands with debug markers
command.debug-markers.expectation: Balanced debug groups and markers decorate the encoder, a compute pass and a render bundle without changing their results.

texture.creation-metadata.title: Inspect texture creation metadata
texture.creation-metadata.expectation: A texture exposes the exact dimensions, mip count, sample count, dimension, format and usage set it was created with, and mip 1 of an array layer reads back where it was written.

texture.view-usage-restriction.title: Restrict a view's usages
texture.view-usage-restriction.expectation: A view limited to TextureBinding samples correctly and is rejected as a render attachment.

texture.depth-aspect-load.title: Load the depth aspect of a combined format
texture.depth-aspect-load.expectation: A DepthOnly view of a Depth24PlusStencil8 texture loads the cleared depth value.

transfers.texture-copy-aspect.title: Copy a depth aspect to a buffer
transfers.texture-copy-aspect.expectation: A DepthOnly copy of Depth32Float writes the depth values and leaves every other byte of the staging buffer intact.

sampler.comparison.title: Compare a depth reference
sampler.comparison.expectation: A Less comparison sampler returns 1 below the depth and 0 above it, with the output sentinel proving both writes.

render.volume-depth-slice.title: Render into one slice of a 3D texture
render.volume-depth-slice.expectation: A colour attachment with depthSlice 1 clears only that slice, leaving the neighbouring slice unchanged.

texture.view-swizzle.title: Swizzle texture view channels
texture.view-swizzle.expectation: b01r and argb views remap the four channels and exercise every swizzle source over an identity control.

texture.one-dimensional-load.title: Load a one-dimensional texture
texture.one-dimensional-load.expectation: texture_1d loads the four texels exactly and reports its width.

render.front-face-culling.title: Cull by declared front face
render.front-face-culling.expectation: The same triangle is kept with frontFace CCW and cullMode Back, and culled when the declared front face or the culled face changes.

render.triangle-strip-restart.title: Restart an indexed triangle strip
render.triangle-strip-restart.expectation: A Uint16 primitive-restart index breaks one strip into two rectangles with an untouched gap.

render.first-index.title: Start indexed drawing at a first index
render.first-index.expectation: drawIndexed with firstIndex selects the tail of the index buffer, while the firstIndex 0 control draws nothing.

render.first-instance.title: Start instanced drawing at a first instance
render.first-instance.expectation: A direct draw with firstInstance 2 sees instance_index 2, while the firstInstance 0 control sees 0.

render.negative-base-vertex.title: Offset indices by a negative base vertex
render.negative-base-vertex.expectation: A negative baseVertex resolves sentinel indices back onto the real vertices without an out-of-bounds access.

depth.read-only-attachment.title: Keep a depth attachment read-only
depth.read-only-attachment.expectation: A depthReadOnly pass tests against the loaded depth without writing it.

stencil.front-back-operations.title: Apply different stencil operations per face
stencil.front-back-operations.expectation: Replace on the front face and IncrementClamp on the back face leave distinct stencil values that two Equal passes paint separately.

depth.bias-slope-clamp.title: Bias depth by slope and clamp it
depth.bias-slope-clamp.expectation: A slope-scaled depth bias rejects the nearer overlay and the clamp restores it.

queue.submitted-work-done.title: Await submitted queue work
queue.submitted-work-done.expectation: onSubmittedWorkDone resolves and the mapped staging reads the four written values, proving the call is usable and the submission completed; the wait itself is not proven.

errors.encoder-finished-twice.title: Finish an encoder twice
errors.encoder-finished-twice.expectation: A second finish reports a validation error while the first command buffer still copies 7.

errors.command-buffer-resubmission.title: Submit a command buffer twice
errors.command-buffer-resubmission.expectation: Re-submitting the same command buffer reports a validation error.

buffers.disjoint-mapped-writes.title: Write two disjoint mapped ranges
buffers.disjoint-mapped-writes.expectation: Two non-overlapping mapped views reach the buffer and read back in order.

errors.overlapping-mapped-ranges.title: Reject overlapping mapped ranges
errors.overlapping-mapped-ranges.expectation: An overlapping CPU-visible range is rejected synchronously, and an adjacent view stays usable.

errors.destroyed-texture-submission.title: Submit work over a destroyed texture
errors.destroyed-texture-submission.expectation: Submitting a finished copy that reads a closed texture reports a validation error.

query.render-timestamp-writes.title: Write and resolve render timestamps
query.render-timestamp-writes.expectation: A render pass resolves begin and end timestamps into the sentinel buffer without disturbing other ranges, and the drawn red is checked; no claim is made that a measurable time was written.

depth.bias-constant.title: Bias depth by a constant
depth.bias-constant.expectation: A constant depth bias moves a coplanar overlay in front of or behind the reference.

render.max-draw-count.title: Cap a pass's draw count
render.max-draw-count.expectation: A pass may not exceed maxDrawCount draws; the accepted cap renders and the exceeded cap reports a validation error.

msaa.alpha-to-coverage-extremes.title: Drive coverage with fragment alpha
msaa.alpha-to-coverage-extremes.expectation: Alpha-to-coverage resolves alpha 0 to the clear and alpha 1 to opaque red, while disabling it writes alpha 0 directly.

bindings.storage-range-length.title: Bound a storage binding by its explicit size
bindings.storage-range-length.expectation: A storage binding's explicit size bounds its runtime array length and its offset selects the first word, even when the backing buffer is larger than either bound range.

errors.min-binding-size.title: Reject a binding below minBindingSize
errors.min-binding-size.expectation: A bind group entry smaller than its layout's minBindingSize is rejected at creation with a validation error, while an entry of exactly that size executes a known write.

errors.bundle-post-execute-state.title: Reset pass state after executing bundles
errors.bundle-post-execute-state.expectation: After executeBundles a draw without rebinding is a validation error even though valid state was bound before the bundle; rebinding a distinct pipeline draws and only that draw can paint the corners.

textures.partial-initialization.title: Read a fresh and a partially written texture
textures.partial-initialization.expectation: A fresh texture reads as transparent black — alpha included — and a partial write changes exactly the addressed texels, with both checks on separate fresh textures.

render.discard-reinit.title: Clear a discarded attachment to zero
render.discard-reinit.expectation: An attachment stored with Discard is cleared to zero by the pass and a following Load pass reads it as transparent black, while its stored sibling keeps its clear colour.

sampling.min-mag-selection.title: Select min and mag filters independently
sampling.min-mag-selection.expectation: With opposite filters on one sampler, level 0 follows magFilter and level 1 follows minFilter; the exactly representable blend weights make the linear results computed, not approximated.

errors.compute-timestamp-indices.title: Validate compute timestamp indices
errors.compute-timestamp-indices.expectation: A compute pass timestamp descriptor with indices inside the query set is accepted and its work runs, while an out-of-range index is a validation error.

errors.render-timestamp-indices.title: Validate render timestamp indices
errors.render-timestamp-indices.expectation: A render pass timestamp descriptor with indices inside the query set is accepted and its pass draws, while an out-of-range index is a validation error.

errors.unenabled-timestamp-feature.title: Refuse a timestamp query set without the feature
errors.unenabled-timestamp-feature.expectation: A device requested without TimestampQuery does not report the feature and refuses a timestamp query set synchronously, while an occlusion query set is created normally.

behaviours.device.features-and-limits: The adapter and device cases check a pinned subset of limits and that a device cannot exceed its adapter; the full limit space is not enumerated.
behaviours.device.request-required-features: Refusing a genuinely absent optional feature has no deterministic portable case; the features present in the environment are requested and used by their cases.
behaviours.features.compressed-and-tiered: Compressed-texture and tiered optional features are declared in the contract but not exercised.
behaviours.features.subgroups: Subgroup features and the reported subgroup sizes are not exercised.
behaviours.features.not-exposed-by-reference-browse: Optional features the reference browser does not expose cannot be exercised here and are not counted as covered.
behaviours.immediates.set-immediates: setImmediates has a public signature but no dedicated optional feature in the catalogue; a zero limit or an older browser cannot be reported as a missing feature, so its extension needs a capabilities/contract work item.
behaviours.texture.creation: The creation case checks the getters and usability of one texture; textureBindingViewDimension and the remaining creation constraints are not exercised.
behaviours.texture.view-usage-aspect: Usage restriction and a DepthOnly view are exercised; a StencilOnly view is not.
behaviours.texture.usage-and-formats: The exercised usages and formats are tied to their cases; compressed, tiered and other formats, plus TransientAttachment, remain untested.
behaviours.textures.storage-constraints: Storage texture format and access constraints beyond the single exercised case are not covered.
behaviours.formats.depth-and-packed: Several depth and stencil formats, and packed formats, are not exercised.
behaviours.sampling.limits: Anisotropy and the sampler limits are not exercised.
behaviours.sampling.comparison-pcf: PCF and comparison functions other than the uniform-depth sampler.comparison case are not exercised.
behaviours.transfers.stencil-copy-aspect: A StencilOnly texture copy aspect is not exercised.
behaviours.render.primitive-and-multisample: Triangle topologies, culling, strip restart and one multisample mask are exercised; points, lines and partial sample masks are not.
behaviours.bundles.negative-validation: Render bundle creation with mismatched attachments is not exercised negatively.
behaviours.errors.device-lost: Device loss has no common access path in the contract (no GPUDevice.lost and no loss callback), so no runner can observe it.
behaviours.async.oom-and-internal-results: Out-of-memory and internal errors cannot be provoked portably; only validation rejection and successful asynchronous results are exercised.
behaviours.data.identifiers-and-indices: Offset, region and index values, including a negative baseVertex, are exercised by their cases; the full 64-bit range of the aliases is not.
